name: Find & Replace Batch
summary: Run multiple find-and-replace rules in order — literal or regex, with case and whole-word options.
description: Stack find/replace rules and apply them top-to-bottom on your text. Each rule can be literal or regex, case-sensitive, and whole-word. See per-rule match counts and copy the final output. Everything runs locally in your browser.

faqs.question: In what order do rules run?
faqs.answer: Top to bottom. Each rule runs on the output of the previous one, so later rules can match text introduced by earlier replacements.

faqs.question: Literal vs regex?
faqs.answer: Literal treats special characters as plain text. Regex mode uses JavaScript regular expressions and supports $1-style group replacements.

faqs.question: Is my text uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. All replacements run entirely in your browser.
